newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Telstra vote delayed in Australian Senate.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Telstra vote delayed in Australian Senate.

text.p: The Australian Senate has fallen behind the government's plan to vote conclusively on the bill to sell a third of telecoms carrier Telstra Corp on Monday afternoon.
A government spokesman said the Senate, currently debating non-government business, would return to Telstra after 5 p.m. (0600 GMT).
But the spokesman said non-government parties might force prolonged debate that could even delay the final vote until Tuesday.
The bill is expected to pass, because the government has answered concerns expressed by the two independents.
The governnment is two votes short of a majority in the Senate, the upper house.
The one-third sale is expected to raise A$8 billion.
